findings.title: 保存したSKILLの本文がworkerへ届かない
findings.root_cause: Presence checks and manifest digests do not include scenario bodies in the actual model input.
findings.condition: A prepared capability has different required skill content.
findings.consequence: Changing the stored rule alone cannot change the worker requirements.
findings.counterevidence: Current common policy deliberately replaces old planner prompts; general research can still proceed.
findings.fix: Pass selected, versioned requirement data in runtime context, separate from the stable host policy.
findings.verification: Different requirements change model inputs and requirement results; versions and cancellation stay bound.

impacts.reason: Conflicts with the explicitly required boundary between scenario data, model interpretation, and shared execution.

findings.title: 語句判定で感情モデルの候補と起動を制限する
findings.root_cause: Semantic choices are preselected by Japanese regex lists.
findings.condition: An expressive paraphrase lacks listed words.
findings.consequence: The normal path can skip the judge and force neutral irrespective of model capability.
findings.counterevidence: Full-candidate mode exists, but the ordinary inference caller does not request it.
findings.fix: Use model interpretation of the full criteria and context; preserve enums, confidence, timeouts, and output bounds.
findings.verification: Paraphrases reach the judge; quotes and negation are evaluated as data rather than new keyword cases.

findings.title: タイマー結果を口調付き定型文へ縮めて渡す
findings.root_cause: A semantic summarizer and persona suffix rules sit before an existing answer LLM.
findings.condition: A list operation returns multiple timers with distinct remaining times.
findings.consequence: actionResult loses per-item facts, requiring reconstruction from other context or losing specificity.
findings.counterevidence: The final response is generated by an LLM; a separate timer snapshot may retain some details.
findings.fix: Pass the public structured receipt fields and persona instructions directly, retaining adoption validation.
findings.verification: All relevant labels, states and times reach the answer model; execution stays once-only.

impacts.reason: Conflicts with the explicitly required boundary between scenario data, model interpretation, and shared execution.

findings.title: 文字種を言語と見なして入力を拒否する
findings.root_cause: Language identity is approximated by scripts and a character blacklist.
findings.condition: Allowed ja with an English acronym, or allowed en with another Latin-script language.
findings.consequence: Legitimate Japanese can be rejected and a disallowed language can be accepted.
findings.counterevidence: The implementation documents missing detected-language metadata from ASR; the script check is not proof of actual language.
findings.fix: Check ASR language capabilities first; use model detection or explicitly narrow the setting, with an explicit unknown state.
findings.verification: Mixed Japanese acronyms pass appropriately; French is not automatically accepted as English.

impacts.reason: Conflicts with the explicitly required boundary between scenario data, model interpretation, and shared execution.

findings.priority_reason: Remove remaining specialized interpretation after the shared contract is available.
findings.title: 単語で意味上の音声強調を決める
findings.root_cause: Notice words and punctuation choose prosody without semantic interpretation.
findings.condition: autoIntonation enabled and decision provider unavailable.
findings.consequence: Negated notice text can still receive notice emphasis.
findings.counterevidence: When the judge is available, execute.ts removes the heuristic parameters.
findings.fix: Use the common semantic decision path and saved baseline on absence; data-driven presets and numerical clamps remain.
findings.verification: Negation and quotation do not trigger keyword-only changes; absence uses a stable baseline.
